Don't get cobra for you, call a local insurance company and get 'emergency' like insurance.  They only pay in case there's an emergency, or admittance to a hospital etc...

Any doctors' appointments etc...you just pay out of pocket.  This is super cheap, like $100 bucks for that month only.

Get your wife Cobra, or even better if she works as you said her losing insurance is a 'Qualifying Life Event'.  Same with you getting insurance in 30 days.  That is also a QLE.  Both can be used to make or change insurance without waiting on open enrollment.
